reasoning_content: Let me check the repository structure and understand the environment. This is SVA Studio, an open-source platform. The installation guide (Installation.md) is actually a runtime profile document. Let me check the available tools (node, pnpm, docker), check the packageManager field in package.json, and check the config/runtime directory.

action.command: cat .nvmrc .node-version .tool-versions; grep -m1 '"packageManager"' package.json; echo ---; node --version 2>&1; pnpm --version 2>&1; npm --version 2>&1; docker --version 2>&1; docker compose version 2>&1 | head -2; git submodule status 2>&1 | head -5
